audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. General-tension scope not justified by unweighted varifold proof; Omitted shortness term and initial error in entropy absorption; Fourier criterion missing pointwise regularity and diagonal normalization
limitations: P1 — General-tension scope not justified by unweighted varifold proof — Counterevidence: Common constant tension can be normalized. Main weighted BV entropy uses correct weights.
P2 — Omitted shortness term and initial error in entropy absorption — Counterevidence: Proposition17 already retains E(0), and the available dissipation controls the omitted mixed term.
P3 — Fourier criterion missing pointwise regularity and diagonal normalization — Counterevidence: Actual Read-Shockley profile already has these properties.
P4 — Incorrect even-term sign in paired positivity series — Counterevidence: No numerical experiment or author code needed; full alpha>0 positivity established analytically.

P5 — Tangential extension sign obstructs core compatibility estimates — Counterevidence: Already-printed beta105 has the correct minus sign and supports the intended repair. Equal-tension BV abstract estimates and the corrected main theorem are not refuted. The leading gradient discrepancy is -2alpha H tau tensor n, whose transpose annihilates n. A full matrix bound is false, but this alone does not disprove the projected transport condition271; a weaker projected repair may suffice.
Limitations: No equivalence with later publisher Version of Record verified.
Limitations: Not a complete independent reconstruction of all104pages; substantial Sections3,6.2,7 and external existence/regularity inputs remain dependencies.
Limitations: No full global counterexample to Theorem19; scope/proof issue established.
Limitations: Correction/supplement search bounded; no relevant correction or executable supplement identified within it.
Limitations: Native helpers are not independently authenticated Pro reviewers or independent acceptance.
Limitations: Backend model not independently verified; conversation URL not exposed.

Replace paired-series argument with exact positivity proof included in report.
